caseno: Civil Petition for Leave to Appeal No. 717 of 2005
lawyer:
Nurul Islam Bhuiyan, Advocate-on-record ------ For the Petitioner.
Respondents ------ Not represented.
parties:
Md. Maniruddin ------ Petitioner
Vs.
Md. Totab Ali @ Kutun Ali being dead his heirs: Mazeda Khatun and others ------ Respondents
full_judgment: 3. The case of the preemptee (opposite party No.1 in the Miscellaneous Case) in short, is that the land sought to be pre-empted is 1.14 acres and the same has been recorded in the name of Wafejuddin alias Afajuddin in ROR khatian No. 146, that land owned by the pre-emptor's predecessor has been listed in ROR khatian No. 148 and as such pre-emptor is not a co-sharer of the land of ROR khatian No. 146 that the preemptee is a stranger in ROR khatian No. 146, and that the pre-emptee has created a separate jama in  respect of his land: and mortgaged the same to the Agricultural Bank in 1982, that Heba-bil-Ewaz deed dated April 4, 1978 was created to the very knowledge of the preemptor and others and the possession of the land gifted was made over to the preemptee, that preemptee is owning and possessing the land of plot No. 322 by cultivating through the bargadar, that opposite party Nos. 2-6 are the heirs of the donor and they were aware of the Heba-bil-Exaz deed and that after the death of the donor when his heirs tried to create trouble there was a 'salish' and as per award of the 'salish' pre-emptee paid Tk. 1,000/- to the opposite party No. 3, that recently defendant Nos. 2 and 3 while disturbing pre-emptee the local Commissioner measured the land fixed the boundary, that the pre-emptor in collaboration with the opposite Nos. 2 and 3 violated the award of the 'salish', that pre-emptor and others had the knowledge about the deed from very beginning and as such contention of the pre-emptor knowing about the deed for the first time on September 1, 1989 is not correct and as such the Miscellaneous case is liable to be dismissed.
